cases.text: Riverbank Seed Library is a free seed lending library in Asheville, North Carolina. Members borrow heirloom seeds in spring and bring back seeds they save after harvest. We started in 2021 with a small grant from a family foundation in Chicago, and we now hold over 300 local varieties.
